# 09 — Add CI, a Persian 404 page, and static integrity checks

<!-- labels: type:ci,area:quality,priority:p2 -->
<!-- agent: devops -->

## Why (Iran market demand)

The repository has no automated checks at all. Every merge is validated by hand,
which is how the stale `#22d3ee` brand color and the fake contact form survived
earlier redesigns. Municipal buyers also poke at URLs: hitting a bad path on a
vendor site currently returns the Nginx default English 404 page, which reads as
an unfinished product.

There is also no `404.html`, so the container's `try_files` fallback is the stock
Nginx error page.

## Scope

1. `.github/workflows/ci.yml` triggered on `push` and `pull_request` to `main`,
   with `permissions: contents: read`, and jobs:
   - **static-checks**: `node --check assets/js/script.js`,
     `node --test tests/`, HTML parse check, `rg` guards for stale brand colors
     and inline styles, anchor-integrity check.
   - **docker-smoke**: `docker build` the image and run it, then `curl -fsS`
     the root path and `robots.txt`/`sitemap.xml` if they exist (skip gracefully
     when absent).
2. `scripts/check-anchors.mjs` — parse `index.html`, collect every `href="#x"`
   and every `id="x"`, fail on any anchor without a target.
3. `404.html` — Persian, uses the same CSS tokens, links back to `/`, has
   `<meta name="robots" content="noindex">`.
4. Nginx config in the image that serves `404.html` for unknown paths with the
   correct status code — add a minimal `nginx/default.conf` and copy it in the
   `Dockerfile`.
5. `Dockerfile` must copy `404.html`, `robots.txt`, and `sitemap.xml` into the
   image (and `.dockerignore` must allow them).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] CI runs on a fresh PR and both jobs pass on `main`.
- [ ] Removing an `id` from a linked section makes **static-checks** fail with a
      clear message naming the broken anchor.
- [ ] Reintroducing `#22d3ee` anywhere in `index.html`, `assets/css`, or
      `assets/js` fails CI.
- [ ] `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:8080/missing-page`
      returns `404` and the body is the Persian page.
- [ ] `curl -I` on `/` returns `200`; the health check still passes.
- [ ] Workflow uses only official actions pinned to a major version, no secrets,
      and `permissions: contents: read`.
- [ ] `.dockerignore` still excludes `.git`, `.github`, `.noqte`, `uploads`,
      `outputs`, `node_modules`; build context stays small.

## Files

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — new
- `scripts/check-anchors.mjs` — new
- `404.html` — new
- `nginx/default.conf` — new
- `Dockerfile`, `.dockerignore` — copy/allowlist the new files
- `README.md` — CI badge + how to run checks locally

## Out of scope

- Deployment/release automation.
- Lighthouse or browser-based performance checks.
- Adding a package manager or lockfile.

## Notes for the agent

Keep every check dependency-free (Node stdlib + grep + docker). Do not add
`npm install` steps. The Docker smoke job is the only place a build runs — it is
expected on GitHub-hosted runners, not inside the Noqte sandbox.
